title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Would it be accurate to say that you guys have talked about keeping Victor in the organization in some capacity
I heard it from a couple people

I asked him what he was going to do and he said he was going to stay and work his cattle ranch and be with his kids activities for the near future. I told him if he wanted to and if he could, to come to Spring Training put the Uni on and help with instruction/coaching etc. and that we would stay in touch as to his future in baseball.
